title: Display Station IDs on the Map Using Map Monitor Quick Select
summary: Use the RMS / fleet status UI Map Monitor Quick Select icon “View Station Ids” to overlay unique station identifiers on the live map. This helps identify/debug station-related issues by confirming station locations and their unique IDs are visible.
when_to_use: When you need to visually confirm station locations and their unique station IDs on the RMS Map Monitor map (stations are special locations distinct from cells) to support station-related identification/debugging.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the RMS Map Monitor Quick Select overlay steps and confirm station IDs appear on the map.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui) with Map Monitor Quick Select panel

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the “View Station Ids” icon and related Quick Select icons (e.g., View all AGV active paths, View Charger Ids, Robot/Cell/Charger selection).

steps.title: Open RMS Map Monitor Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Get to the Map Monitor Quick Select area where the station ID overlay control is located.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (Map Monitor) and locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.
steps.expected_result: The left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel is visible with Quick Select icons including “View Station Ids”.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons on the left panel, including the “View Station Ids” icon.
steps.failure_condition: The “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel is not visible or the “View Station Ids” icon is not present.

actions.label: Locate Quick Select panel
actions.exact_action: Locate the left-side “Map Monitor Quick Select” panel.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Station IDs” are unique IDs for stations (special locations distinct from cells) and are shown by clicking the station IDs icon.
Map Monitor Quick Select panel includes “View Station Ids” icon.

steps.title: Select “View Station Ids” overlay
steps.purpose: Enable the station ID overlay so station unique IDs display on the map.
steps.instruction: Click the “View Station Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel.
steps.expected_result: Station locations on the map display unique station IDs after selecting “View Station Ids”.
steps.healthy_condition: Unique station IDs appear at station locations on the map.
steps.failure_condition: Station IDs do not appear on the map after selecting “View Station Ids”.

actions.label: Enable station ID overlay
actions.exact_action: Click the “View Station Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel.

stop_or_escalate_if: If station IDs do not appear when the overlay is selected, stop and escalate for further RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Station IDs” are unique IDs for stations (special locations distinct from cells) and are shown by clicking the station IDs icon.

steps.title: Verify station unique IDs display on the map
steps.purpose: Confirm the overlay is working and that station IDs are visible at station locations.
steps.instruction: On the map, verify that station locations display unique station IDs.
steps.expected_result: Station locations show unique station IDs on the map.
steps.healthy_condition: Station locations (special locations distinct from cells) have visible unique station IDs.
steps.failure_condition: Station locations do not show unique station IDs (overlay appears ineffective or not rendering).

actions.label: Check station ID overlay
actions.exact_action: Verify that station locations display unique station IDs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If station IDs do not appear, stop and escalate for further RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Stations are special locations with unique IDs; clicking the station IDs icon shows them.
Transcript explains station IDs are unique IDs for stations and are important for debugging/identifying problems.

success_criteria: After selecting “View Station Ids”, station locations on the RMS Map Monitor map display unique station IDs.
healthy_conditions: Station locations (special locations distinct from cells) show visible unique station IDs on the map overlay.
failure_conditions: Station IDs do not appear on the map after selecting “View Station Ids”.
escalation_guidance: If station IDs do not display when the overlay is selected, stop and escalate for further RMS map/overlay troubleshooting.
